<?php
$before = new class {};
class R182Named { public static function make() { return static function() { return new class {}; }; } }
$f = R182Named::make(); $a = $f(); $b = $f(); $after = new class {};
echo $before::class, ';', $a::class, ';', $after::class, ';', ($a !== $b), ';', ($a::class === $b::class), ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function make($value) { return fn() => new class($value) { public function __construct(public int $value) {} }; } };
$f = $owner->make(7); unset($owner); $child = $f(); echo $child->value, ';', $child::class, ';';

<?php
class R182Ref { public function make(&$value) { return function() use (&$value) { return new class(++$value) { public function __construct(public int $value) {} }; }; } }
$owner = new R182Ref; $value = 3; $f = $owner->make($value); $a = $f(); $b = $f(); echo $value, ';', $a->value, ';', $b->value, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function make() { return static function() { return static fn() => new class {}; }; } };
$outer = $owner->make(); $inner = $outer(); $a = $inner(); $after = new class {}; echo $owner::class, ';', $a::class, ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
class R182Default { private int $value = 9; public function make() { return function(int $n = 3): object { echo $this->value, ';', self::class, ';', $n, ';'; return new class {}; }; } }
$owner = new R182Default; $f = $owner->make(); unset($owner); $a = $f(); echo $a::class, ';';

<?php
class R182Parent { protected function __construct(public int $value) {} }
$owner = new class extends R182Parent { public function __construct() {} public function make() { return fn($value = 4) => new class($value) extends R182Parent {}; } };
$f = $owner->make(); $a = $f(); echo $a->value, ';', $owner::class, ';', $a::class, ';';

<?php
$saved = null;
try { $owner = new class($saved) { public function __construct(&$saved) { $saved = static function() { return new class {}; }; throw new Exception('fail'); } public function __destruct() { echo 'BAD;'; } }; } catch (Exception $e) { echo 'caught;'; }
$child = $saved(); echo $child::class, ';';

<?php
class R182Bad { public static function make() { return static function() { return new class { public function child(int $value = 'bad') {} }; }; } }
echo 'BAD;';

<?php
$owner = new class { public static function __construct() { $f = static function() { return new class { final private function f() {} }; }; } };

<?php
class R182Final { final public function f() {} }
class R182Link { public static function make() { return static fn() => new class(echo_bad()) extends R182Final { public function f() {} }; } }
function echo_bad() { echo 'BAD;'; return 1; }
$f = R182Link::make(); try { $f(); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), ';'; }

<?php
class R182Void { public static function make() { return static function(): void { return new class { public function f(int $x = 'bad') {} }; }; } }

<?php
$saved = null; $owner = new class($saved) { public function __construct(&$saved) { $saved = fn() => new class {}; } };
$a = $saved(); $b = $saved(); echo $owner::class, ';', $a::class, ';', ($a !== $b), ';';

<?php
class R182Magic { public function make() { echo __FUNCTION__, '|', __METHOD__, '|', __CLASS__, ';'; return function() { echo __FUNCTION__, '|', __METHOD__, '|', __CLASS__, ';'; return fn() => __METHOD__; }; } }
$f = (new R182Magic)->make(); $g = $f(); echo $g(), ';';

<?php
$owner = new class {
 public function make() {
  return function() {
   echo __METHOD__, ';';
   return fn() => new class(__METHOD__) { public function __construct(string $name) { echo $name, ';'; } };
  };
 }
};
$f = $owner->make(); $g = $f(); $child = $g(); echo $child::class, ';';

<?php
class Owner182G { function make(){return function(){echo __METHOD__===__FUNCTION__ ? 'closure-name|' : 'BAD|'; yield 1;};} function stream(){echo __METHOD__==='Owner182G::stream' ? 'method-name|' : 'BAD|';yield 2;} }
class Receiver182G {} $owner=new Owner182G(); $source=$owner->make(); $gen=$source->call(new Receiver182G()); echo $gen->current()===1,'|'; unset($gen); $fake=$owner->stream(...); $gen=$fake->call(new Owner182G()); echo $gen->current()===2,'|';
